detailed_description:
The target video is a living graphic-novel illustration in <Subject 1>: ink lines stay crisp, the rain falls in bright streaks through the lamplight, and the mood is tense and cinematic.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, wide on the rainy alley. The camera pushes in toward the masked man in one slow, perfectly steady forward move that lasts the whole shot, never pausing and never pulling back. Rain pours through the orange lamplight, steam curls out of the glowing doorway and drifts low across the wet cobblestones, and the puddles ripple and shine. The walkie-talkie crackles; he presses the talk button and answers in a low voice, the mask moving as he speaks. Lightning flickers once behind the tower, lighting up the falling rain and flashing off his gold chain. Then he turns his eyes straight into the lens with a cold stare, holds it for a beat, and cuts them back to the street as he keeps listening. The camera is still pushing in as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain on brick and stone, water dripping from the viaduct, a hiss of steam from the doorway, crackling radio static and a muffled voice on the walkie-talkie, his low voice answering, a distant roll of thunder after the flicker.
